title: Taint analysis (SQL, command, path, deserialization, HTML, log)
summary: Six taint rules (SQL, command, path, deserialization, HTML, log) follow index data_flows facts from a source to a sink
intro: Read this when you want to find tainted values reaching a SQL, command or file-path sink across routines and units. The rules run in lint-all and in lint with a store; the catalogues of sources, sinks and propagators are editable JSON. Since 1.56 the deserialization, HTML-output and log rules are built in, and a value flowing through the else part of an except block is followed (wiki section Taint through exceptions).
